label: Sarah's 30th birthday party invitation
subject: You're invited! Sarah's 30th Birthday – April 12
body:
Hey everyone!

You're invited to celebrate Sarah's 30th Birthday!

Event: Sarah's 30th Birthday Celebration
Date: Sunday, April 12, 2026
Time: 7:00 PM (doors open at 6:45 PM)
Location: The Rooftop Lounge, 450 Grand Avenue, Oakland, CA 94610

We're planning an amazing evening of cocktails, a sit-down dinner, and dancing to celebrate our favorite person turning the big 3-0. The restaurant has a gorgeous view of the Oakland hills and a private section reserved just for our group.

Dress code is smart casual — think nice jeans and a blazer, or a cocktail dress. No need to go full formal, just look a little sharp!

We're asking everyone to contribute $45 toward a group gift for Sarah — I'll collect via Venmo (@amandachen88) before April 8th. And please RSVP by April 5th so we can give the restaurant an accurate headcount.

Hope to see everyone there! Feel free to forward this to Mike, Jenny, and Carlos — the more the merrier!

With love,
Amanda
